title: What If Earth's Tectonic Plates Stopped Moving?

scenes.text: What if Earth's plates stopped moving tomorrow? The first change would be quiet.
Along the Ring of Fire, volcanism would shut off, and big earthquakes would become far less frequent.
Mountains would stop growing. Rain and ice would grind them down to low rolling hills in a few million years.
Plates are also how Earth releases its inner heat. Without them, scientists aren't sure how the planet would cool.
The carbon cycle that recycles carbon dioxide through volcanoes would end, and the reshuffling of continents that drives evolution would stop.
In the final stages, researchers say, Earth would end up a dead planet, like Mercury.
